decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the available products focusing specifically on versatile backpacks suitable for daily use or hiking. Many items in the feed were miscategorized (tents, pillows, stoves), so I filtered those out. The Seibertron Falcon (prod_backpacks_107) became the clear choice due to its high volume of reviews (nearly 3,000) and consistent 4.6-star rating. It offers substantial capacity (37L) and durable construction at a fair price point compared to the more specialized or lower-quality budget options like the KAUKKO or the mesh adidas bag. The review from the 'Sea Turtle Tracker' specifically highlighted its durability for heavy field use, which gave me confidence in the product's longevity.
